prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one production transparent shipwreck environment sprite for a hand-painted overhead fantasy RPG. Input image is the approved nine-terrain art direction board, STYLE reference only. Create one isolated empty broken small wooden riverboat hull, about 7 metres long and 2.6 metres wide, lying very low, its long axis running roughly left to right. Orthographic three-quarter game camera from above about 40 degrees, consistent with the reference. Rich but restrained hand-painted aged grey-brown oak, worn curved gunwales, exposed curved timber ribs, a few broken missing planks, old iron nails and one short frayed rope attached inside. One end slightly crushed and split, readable asymmetrical silhouette, broad near-facing side and quiet top surfaces, no tall mast or sails. Soft neutral upper-left light, delicate crevice shadows, subdued natural material colors, no orange varnish, no photographic collage, no heavy dark ground shadow. The interior gaps between ribs must be truly transparent. Entire surrounding background must be genuine transparent alpha; no water, shore, floor, base, scenery or checkerboard. Whole wreck fits inside square canvas with generous transparent margin. Requested 1536x1024 landscape if possible, but keep the entire object and transparency. No people, skeletons, monsters, cargo, crates, treasure, flags, symbols, text, numbers, logo or watermark. Match the reference's painterly stone-and-wood environment quality, not cartoon vector art, not a glossy 3D render.

artReview.subject: Empty low broken riverboat hull with exposed ribs
artReview.style: Muted hand-painted aged timber consistent with approved direction
